firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Could the Kaggle/ARC hosts clarify Milestone 2 open-source eligibility for a dependency? Suppose a publicly released, open-source-licensed solution notebook executes source files from a separate public Kaggle Dataset whose card says “License: Unknown.” The notebook author does not own or relicense those files. Does the milestone requirement consider that solution open-sourced, or must the executable-source dependency itself have a verified open-source grant (or be replaced) for eligibility?

We have separately asked the dataset publisher about redistribution and modification rights. This question is only about competition eligibility; it does not ask the hosts to grant those rights. A clarification before the September 30 deadline would help us choose a compliant release path.
